description: This file contains Redux reducers and related functions for managing user entities in the Mattermost Redux state, including user profiles, sessions, statuses, and group/channel memberships.

methods.name: profilesToSet
methods.description: Converts data from an action into a set of user profiles associated with a team.

methods.name: removeProfilesFromSet
methods.description: Removes multiple user profiles from a set based on action data.

methods.name: profileListToSet
methods.description: Replaces or adds a list of user profiles to the state, associated with a team.

methods.name: removeProfileListFromSet
methods.description: Removes a list of user profiles from a set.

methods.name: addProfileToSet
methods.description: Adds a single user profile to a set.

methods.name: removeProfileFromSets
methods.description: Removes a user profile from all sets where it exists.

methods.name: removeProfileFromSet
methods.description: Removes a specific user profile from a set.

methods.name: currentUserId
methods.description: Reducer managing the current user's ID based on actions like login, logout, and profile updates.

methods.name: mySessions
methods.description: Reducer managing the list of user sessions.

methods.name: myAudits
methods.description: Reducer managing user audit logs.

methods.name: receiveUserProfile
methods.description: Merges incoming user profile data into the state, handling sensitive data and merging logic.

methods.name: profiles
methods.description: Reducer managing user profile objects, handling profile updates, merges, and visibility.

methods.name: profilesInTeam
methods.description: Reducer managing sets of user IDs in teams.

methods.name: profilesNotInTeam
methods.description: Reducer managing sets of user IDs not in teams.

methods.name: profilesInChannel
methods.description: Reducer managing sets of user IDs in channels.

methods.name: profilesNotInChannel
methods.description: Reducer managing sets of user IDs not in channels.

methods.name: profilesInGroup
methods.description: Reducer managing sets of user IDs in groups.

methods.name: profilesNotInGroup
methods.description: Reducer managing sets of user IDs not in groups.

methods.name: dndEndTimes
methods.description: Reducer managing Do Not Disturb end times per user.

methods.name: statuses
methods.description: Reducer managing user statuses.

methods.name: isManualStatus
methods.description: Reducer managing flags indicating if user statuses are manually set.

methods.name: myUserAccessTokens
methods.description: Reducer managing user access tokens.

methods.name: stats
methods.description: Reducer managing total user statistics.

methods.name: filteredStats
methods.description: Reducer managing filtered user statistics.

methods.name: lastActivity
methods.description: Reducer managing last activity timestamps for users.
